name: Charts
description: Brand-configurable SVG bar, pie/donut and line charts. One copy includes the shared brand specification, deterministic styling, accessible data tables and optional CSS entrance animation.
whenToUse: Comparisons, part-to-whole data and trends that must follow a saved brand's chart rules. Copy Charts.tsx once and configure a shared ChartBrand; use BarChart, PieChart or LineChart from sections. Start from skeleton.charts.tsx. Supply stable category/series IDs, a surface name, semantic roles and any highlighted IDs; colors and typography belong in the brand specification. Supports grouped/stacked and horizontal bars, pie/donut, missing line values, background restrictions and optional animation without hydration. NOT a general plotting library, real-time dashboard interaction engine, scatterplot or infographic illustration tool. Font assets are loaded by the consuming design system.
